title: Microsoft Defender External Attack Surface Management
descriptionMarkdown: MDEASM data connector gives richer insights into security events by supplementing details about externally exposed assets and their attack surfaces. Data from this connector helps identify and monitor internet-facing resources, vulnerabilities, and potential security risks across your organization's external attack surface. [Learn about MDEASM.](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/external-attack-surface-management/overview)
